lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno grabbed a hammer, tap,
A nail upon a wooden cap!
Kiki clapped, but here's the thing,
It means you got it right, ding ding!
[chorus]
Hit the nail on the head, hit the nail on the head,
Exactly right, that's what you said!
Hit the nail on the head, hit the nail on the head,
Spot on, perfect, nothing to dread!
[verse]
It means you got it just right,
The perfect answer, shining bright,
You found the point, you got it true,
Hit the nail, well done, it's you!
[chorus]
Hit the nail on the head, hit the nail on the head,
Exactly right, that's what you said!
Hit the nail on the head, hit the nail on the head,
Bang on right, go on ahead!
[outro]
So when you're right in what you said,
You hit the nail right on the head!
